title: First Steps
summary: Get to know your guitar: hold it, tune it, read tab and chord diagrams, and play your first notes and melody.

title: Open Chords I
summary: Seven essential open chords (Em, Am, E, A, D, G and C), clean fretting and smooth changes over steady downstrokes.

title: Rhythm Foundations
summary: Down and up strums, eighth notes, the strum patterns behind countless songs, steady time and your first full songs.

title: Open Chords II & Riffs
summary: Seventh and suspended chords, more colourful changes and classic single-note riffs.

title: Barre & Power Chords
summary: Power chords, palm muting and your first barre chords, F and Bm.

title: Lead Guitar I
summary: The minor pentatonic scale, hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides and bends, and your first short solos.

title: Fingerstyle & Theory
summary: Fingerpicking patterns, the major scale, and how keys and chords fit together.

title: Intermediate Musician
summary: Longer songs, quicker changes, mixed strumming and picking, and playing by ear.
